__broaden__.tutum: tutum — each, every one (pronoun or adjective; Ming 各各) [各各] · also 'each time, every turn' (Ming 每遍), as in toγ̇oriqui tutum 'each time they wheel'
__broaden__.γarγažu: γar- — to go out; causative -γa- + converb -žu, 'making go out, driving out' (verb, causative converb) [逐出着] · also 'drawing out' a knife (kituγai γarγažu, 'drawing a knife'; Ming 出着) · also 'raising' dust (toγ̇osun γarγažu, 'dust raised'; the Ming 望着 'looking toward' does not fit, so the grammar is followed)
__broaden__.bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'when setting off, on starting' (the participle neġükü + bolun; Ming 做呵 'when doing'; uncertain) · also bol- 'to become' with converb -un in the sense 'together, as one' (Ming 共) · also bol- with the Ming 上頭 'on account of, therefore' [上頭] · also the Ming 欲做 'wishing to do, about to' (uncertain) [欲做] · also bol- 'to cease, stop' + converb -un (Ming 住) · also dobtulqu bolun 'about to charge, bent on charging' (Ming 要 'wish to'; compare bailduqu bolun)

__broaden__.jer: -jer — an ending of uncertain force, with the shape of the instrumental (the token left after sem(i)-; the Ming 噤聲的 glosses the whole word) [噤聲的] · also -jer after mör(i)-, 'along, by (the road)', instrumental (Ming 行) · also after tümed(i)-, 'with, by the tümens' (instrumental; Ming 萬(每)敎), and after ebür(i)-, 'along the front' (Ming (前)行) · also -jer after köl(i)-, 'with the foot' (instrumental; Ming 腳用, the whole word) · also after čerig(i)-, 'with the army' (instrumental; Ming 軍(依着)), where the (i) is Shiratori's
__broaden__.jar: -jar — instrumental: with, by means of (case suffix; the token left after moṅgirsun(i)-; the Ming 敎 marks the means) [薤敎] · also in jabuγad(i)-jar, 'on foot' (Ming 步行着, the whole word; the token left after jabuγad(i)-, analysis uncertain) · also after arasun(i)- ('with the hide', Ming 皮子敎), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Turqaγ̇ud(i)- (a mountain name; Ming 依着), 'along, by way of the Turqaqud' · also in γar(i)-jar, 'with the hand' (instrumental; Ming 手用, the whole word; the token left after γar(i)-) · also after uruγ(i)- ('with one's whole clan'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also γažar(i)-jar, 'by way of the land, through' (Ming 地面 裏 / 地行) · also after turγaγ̇ud(i)-, 'leading the guards' (Ming 護衞(每)領着, 領着 'leading', uncertain)
__broaden__.jari: -jar — instrumental: with, together with (case suffix, uncertain; the token jar(i), the (i) being Shiratori's linking vowel before the reflexive -jan; left as its own token after uruk(i)- and aimak(i)-) [一族 自的行] · also jar(i)- after Uruγ̇ud- and Moṅγud-, 'leading' (Ming 領着, uncertain), before the reflexive -jan
__broaden__.turγaγ̇udi: turγaγ̇ — companion, follower (Ming 伴當, the same gloss as nökör); plural -d; the (i) is Shiratori's, before the reflexive -jan (noun + plural, with a linking vowel) [伴當的每(自的行)] · also 'bodyguard, guards' (Ming 護衞(每)領着) in turγaγ̇ud(i)-jar, 'leading the guards'; the (i) is Shiratori's
__broaden__.nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere · also küġün-(n)u, 'of a person' · also printed after Waṅ-Qān-(n)u, 'of Wang Qan' (Ming 的), where the (n) is Shiratori's
__broaden__.nača: -(n)ača — ablative: from (back-vowel form; the token left after Burqan-Qaldun-(n)-, 'from Burqan Qaldun') [山名 自] · also after Qaγan-(n)-, 'from the Qaγan' (ablative; the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 皇帝 行 writes 行, not 處) · also after Waṅ-Qān-(n)-, 'from Wang Qan' (Ming 處 'at the place of')
__broaden__.dür: -dür — dative-locative: at, in (front-vowel form; the token left after a hyphen, e.g. -dür following a participle; Ming 裏) (case suffix) [裏] · also -dür after a participle or negative, 'at the time of, when' (Ming 時), as in ügei-dür 'when there was none' · also glossed 的(處), 'of, at the side of', as in köġün-dür 'in the matter of the son'
__broaden__.čerigi: čerig — soldier, army (noun); the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen: 'one's own troops' [軍 自的行] · also the token left in čerig(i)-jer, 'with the army' (the (i) is Shiratori's; Ming 軍(依着))
